name: Camper radial follows native body modifier
manualSteps: Inspect a bare pickup radial before installing the camper modifier
Install modVehicleCamperBody using the native vehicle modify UI and close that UI
Reopen radial: storage management, stations, defense, use station and registered energy actions appear
Remove body when existing occupied-removal guards permit it
Reopen radial: camper-specific commands disappear and native vehicle commands remain
Repeat install/remove and save/reload on host and remote client
limits: Offline fixtures verify production cache invalidation and prefix mutation. Manual game scenario is supplied but not executed.
